question_text: A laptop originally priced at P45,000 is sold at a 20% discount. What is the selling price?

hint_ladder.title: Orient
hint_ladder.text: Isipin mo 'yung laptop sa sale. Original P45,000, may 20% discount. Kailangan natin malaman ang presyong ibebenta.

hint_ladder.title: Rule
hint_ladder.text: Para makuha discount: Multiply original price sa discount rate as decimal. Ang 20% ay 0.20. Discount = P45,000 × 0.20.

hint_ladder.title: Apply
hint_ladder.text: Compute discount: 45,000 × 0.20 = 9,000. Ito yung matitipid mo. Ibawas sa original: 45,000 – 9,000 = ?

hint_ladder.title: Nearly There
hint_ladder.text: Discount ay P9,000, so selling price = P45,000 – P9,000 = P36,000. Isang shortcut: P45,000 × 0.80 = P36,000 din. Go mo na!

A.text: You might have chosen A because you subtracted P11,000, miscalculating 20% as 24%. Real discount is P9,000, so selling price is higher.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you subtracted a neat P10,000, but 20% of P45,000 is P9,000, not P10,000. Check: 0.20×45,000=9,000.

C.text: Correct. You computed 20% of P45,000 as P9,000, or directly paid 80% (P45,000×0.80). Selling price is P36,000.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you subtracted only P8,000, underestimating the discount. 20% of 45,000 is 9,000, so selling price is 36,...

next_time_rule: Pag may discount: Selling Price = Original x (1 – Discount Rate as decimal). Tandaan, '20% off' means 80% to pay. Multiply sa original para diretso.
deconstruct_text:
Sa isang 'Balik Eskwela' gadget fair sa Barangay Batis, may laptop na P45,000, 20% ang discount. Magkano na lang? Simple lang: 'yung 20% na ibinawas, kunin mo muna.

20% in decimal is 0.20. I-multiply mo sa P45,000: 45,000 × 0.20 = 9,000. Ito ang discount, ang matitipid mo. Kaya ang selling price ay 45,000 minus 9,000 = 36,000.

Mental trick: Pag may discount, isipin mo agad kung ilang percent ang babayaran. 100% – 20% = 80%. So imbes na dalawang step, multiply mo na lang 45,000 × 0.80, diretso 36,000.

Tandaan: 'yung 20% discount, hindi P10,000 ha? Baka isipin mo round number, pero 20% ng 45,000 ay exactly 9,000. I-divide mo lang by 5, kasi 20% = 1/5. 45,000/5=9,000. 'Yun ang mabilis na mental anchor.
